description: Renders slides of a report as images, as viewers see them, so you can check how they look: text that overflows or overlaps, or a chart too small to read. After a message's turn, pass its replies' changedSlideIds. At most 10 slides a call; hidden slides are left out. Counts against the 10 exports a minute per user.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

slideIds.description: The slides to render, from `getReportContent` or a reply's `changedSlideIds`. Hidden slides and ids that are not slides of the report are ignored. 1 to 10 ids: repeat the parameter for each one, as in `?slideIds=a&slideIds=b`.

name: getReportSlideImages
title: Get slide images
